verses.text: I am the man who has seen affliction Because of the rod of His wrath.
verses.textZh: 我是因耶和華忿怒的杖，遭遇困苦的人。

verses.text: He has driven me and made me walk In darkness and not in light.
verses.textZh: 他引導我，使我行在黑暗中，不行在光明裡。

verses.text: Surely against me He has turned His hand Repeatedly all the day.
verses.textZh: 他真是終日再三反手攻擊我。

verses.text: He has caused my flesh and my skin to waste away, He has broken my bones.
verses.textZh: 他使我的皮肉枯乾；他折斷（或譯：壓傷）我的骨頭。

verses.text: He has besieged and encompassed me with bitterness and hardship.
verses.textZh: 他築壘攻擊我，用苦楚（原文是苦膽）和艱難圍困我。

verses.text: In dark places He has made me dwell, Like those who have long been dead.
verses.textZh: 他使我住在幽暗之處，像死了許久的人一樣。

verses.text: He has walled me in so that I cannot go out; He has made my chain heavy.
verses.textZh: 他用籬笆圍住我，使我不能出去；他使我的銅鍊沉重。

verses.text: Even when I cry out and call for help, He shuts out my prayer.
verses.textZh: 我哀號求救；他使我的禱告不得上達。

verses.text: He has blocked my ways with hewn stone; He has made my paths crooked.
verses.textZh: 他用鑿過的石頭擋住我的道；他使我的路彎曲。

verses.text: He is to me like a bear lying in wait, [Like] a lion in secret places.
verses.textZh: 他向我如熊埋伏，如獅子在隱密處。

verses.text: He has turned aside my ways and torn me to pieces; He has made me desolate.
verses.textZh: 他使我轉離正路，將我撕碎，使我淒涼。

verses.text: He bent His bow And set me as a target for the arrow.
verses.textZh: 他張弓將我當作箭靶子。

verses.text: He made the arrows of His quiver To enter into my inward parts.
verses.textZh: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。

verses.text: I have become a laughingstock to all my people, Their [mocking] song all the day.
verses.textZh: 我成了眾民的笑話；他們終日以我為歌曲。

verses.text: He has filled me with bitterness, He has made me drunk with wormwood.
verses.textZh: 他用苦楚充滿我，使我飽用茵蔯。

verses.text: He has broken my teeth with gravel; He has made me cower in the dust.
verses.textZh: 他又用沙石磣斷我的牙，用灰塵將我蒙蔽。

verses.text: My soul has been rejected from peace; I have forgotten happiness.
verses.textZh: 你使我遠離平安，我忘記好處。

verses.text: So I say, 'My strength has perished, And [so has] my hope from the LORD.'
verses.textZh: 我就說：我的力量衰敗；我在耶和華那裡毫無指望！

verses.text: Remember my affliction and my wandering, the wormwood and bitterness.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你記念我如茵蔯和苦膽的困苦窘迫。

verses.text: Surely my soul remembers And is bowed down within me.
verses.textZh: 我心想念這些，就在裡面憂悶。

verses.text: This I recall to my mind, Therefore I have hope.
verses.textZh: 我想起這事，心裡就有指望。

verses.text: The LORD'S lovingkindnesses indeed never cease, For His compassions never fail.
verses.textZh: 我們不致消滅，是出於耶和華諸般的慈愛；是因他的憐憫不致斷絕。

verses.text: [They] are new every morning; Great is Your faithfulness.
verses.textZh: 每早晨，這都是新的；你的誠實極其廣大！

verses.text: 'The LORD is my portion,' says my soul, 'Therefore I have hope in Him.'
verses.textZh: 我心裡說：耶和華是我的分，因此，我要仰望他。

verses.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, To the person who seeks Him.
verses.textZh: 凡等候耶和華，心裡尋求他的，耶和華必施恩給他。

verses.text: [It is] good that he waits silently For the salvation of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 人仰望耶和華，靜默等候他的救恩，這原是好的。

verses.text: [It is] good for a man that he should bear The yoke in his youth.
verses.textZh: 人在幼年負軛，這原是好的。

verses.text: Let him sit alone and be silent Since He has laid [it] on him.
verses.textZh: 他當獨坐無言，因為這是耶和華加在他身上的。

verses.text: Let him put his mouth in the dust, Perhaps there is hope.
verses.textZh: 他當口貼塵埃，或者有指望。

verses.text: Let him give his cheek to the smiter, Let him be filled with reproach.
verses.textZh: 他當由人打他的腮頰，要滿受凌辱。

verses.text: For the Lord will not reject forever,
verses.textZh: 因為主必不永遠丟棄人。

verses.text: For if He causes grief, Then He will have compassion According to His abundant lovingkindness.
verses.textZh: 主雖使人憂愁，還要照他諸般的慈愛發憐憫。

verses.text: For He does not afflict willingly Or grieve the sons of men.
verses.textZh: 因他並不甘心使人受苦，使人憂愁。

verses.text: To crush under His feet All the prisoners of the land,
verses.textZh: 人將世上被囚的踹（原文是壓）在腳下，

verses.text: To deprive a man of justice In the presence of the Most High,
verses.textZh: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，

verses.text: To defraud a man in his lawsuit-- Of these things the Lord does not approve.
verses.textZh: 或在人的訟事上顛倒是非，這都是主看不上的。

verses.text: Who is there who speaks and it comes to pass, Unless the Lord has commanded [it]?
verses.textZh: 除非主命定，誰能說成就成呢？

verses.text: [Is it] not from the mouth of the Most High That both good and ill go forth?
verses.textZh: 禍福不都出於至高者的口嗎？

verses.text: Why should [any] living mortal, or [any] man, Offer complaint in view of his sins?
verses.textZh: 活人因自己的罪受罰，為何發怨言呢？

verses.text: Let us examine and probe our ways, And let us return to the LORD.
verses.textZh: 我們當深深考察自己的行為，再歸向耶和華。

verses.text: We lift up our heart and hands Toward God in heaven;
verses.textZh: 我們當誠心向天上的神舉手禱告。

verses.text: We have transgressed and rebelled, You have not pardoned.
verses.textZh: 我們犯罪背逆，你並不赦免。

verses.text: You have covered [Yourself] with anger And pursued us; You have slain [and] have not spared.
verses.textZh: 你自被怒氣遮蔽，追趕我們；你施行殺戮，並不顧惜。

verses.text: You have covered Yourself with a cloud So that no prayer can pass through.
verses.textZh: 你以黑雲遮蔽自己，以致禱告不得透入。

verses.text: [You have made us mere] offscouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples.
verses.textZh: 你使我們在萬民中成為污穢和渣滓。

verses.text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.textZh: 我們的仇敵都向我們大大張口。

verses.text: Panic and pitfall have befallen us, Devastation and destruction;
verses.textZh: 恐懼和陷坑，殘害和毀滅，都臨近我們。

verses.text: My eyes run down with streams of water Because of the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textZh: 因我眾民遭的毀滅，我就眼淚下流如河。

verses.text: My eyes pour down unceasingly, Without stopping,
verses.textZh: 我的眼多多流淚，總不止息，

verses.text: Until the LORD looks down And sees from heaven.
verses.textZh: 直等耶和華垂顧，從天觀看。

verses.text: My eyes bring pain to my soul Because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.textZh: 因我本城的眾民，我的眼，使我的心傷痛。

verses.text: My enemies without cause Hunted me down like a bird;
verses.textZh: 無故與我為仇的追逼我，像追雀鳥一樣。

verses.text: They have silenced me in the pit And have placed a stone on me.
verses.textZh: 他們使我的命在牢獄中斷絕，並將一塊石頭拋在我身上。

verses.text: Waters flowed over my head; I said, 'I am cut off!'
verses.textZh: 眾水流過我頭，我說：我命斷絕了！

verses.text: I called on Your name, O LORD, Out of the lowest pit.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我從深牢中求告你的名。

verses.text: You have heard my voice, 'Do not hide Your ear from my [prayer for] relief, From my cry for help.'
verses.textZh: 你曾聽見我的聲音；我求你解救，你不要掩耳不聽。

verses.text: You drew near when I called on You; You said, 'Do not fear!'
verses.textZh: 我求告你的日子，你臨近我，說：不要懼怕！

verses.text: O Lord, You have pleaded my soul's cause; You have redeemed my life.
verses.textZh: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤；你救贖了我的命。

verses.text: O LORD, You have seen my oppression; Judge my case.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你見了我受的委屈；求你為我伸冤。

verses.text: You have seen all their vengeance, All their schemes against me.
verses.textZh: 他們仇恨我，謀害我，你都看見了。

verses.text: You have heard their reproach, O LORD, All their schemes against me.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你聽見他們辱罵我的話，知道他們向我所設的計，

verses.text: The lips of my assailants and their whispering [Are] against me all day long.
verses.textZh: 並那些起來攻擊我的人口中所說的話，以及終日向我所設的計謀。

verses.text: Look on their sitting and their rising; I am their mocking song.
verses.textZh: 求你觀看，他們坐下，起來，都以我為歌曲。

verses.text: You will recompense them, O LORD, According to the work of their hands.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你要按著他們手所做的向他們施行報應。

verses.text: You will give them hardness of heart, Your curse will be on them.
verses.textZh: 你要使他們心裡剛硬，使你的咒詛臨到他們。

verses.text: You will pursue them in anger and destroy them From under the heavens of the LORD!
verses.textZh: 你要發怒追趕他們，從耶和華的天下除滅他們。
